name: repo-flow
description: Codify the repository workflow: commit hygiene, branch and pull request lifecycle, evidence-backed diff review, and CI triage, with a GitHub MCP connector for pull requests and check logs.
descriptionZh: 将仓库工作流标准化：提交规范、分支与 Pull Request 生命周期、基于证据的 diff 评审，以及 CI 失败定位；内置 GitHub MCP 连接器用于读取 PR 与检查日志。

commit-check.description: Audit staged changes and shape a well-formed commit before committing.

branch-hygiene.description: Report stale branches, merged work, and branch drift across local and remote.

pr-ready.description: Check a branch against PR readiness: scope, tests, description, and reviewability.

review-diff.description: Run the diff-reviewer subagent over a diff and report line-level findings.

ci-triage.description: Read failing CI output and localise the break to a commit, job, or test.

interface.shortDescription: Commit, branch, review, and CI triage workflows for Git repos
interface.longDescription: Use Repo Flow to keep a repository tidy while working. It shapes commits that match the project's convention, audits branch and pull request state, reviews diffs for real bugs and convention drift with a dedicated reviewer subagent, and turns failing CI output into a specific commit, job, or test to fix. The GitHub MCP connector supplies pull request detail and check-run logs when local git history is not enough.
defaultPrompt: Check my staged changes before I commit
Review the diff against main and flag real bugs
Why did CI fail on this branch?
Which local branches are safe to delete?
